observations: Original and upper/lower crops compared with mobility reference and canonical light face; actual overlay viewed. Face braid stance retained, fanned thruster panels glow purple. Temple fin remains clipped and outer right fan reaches edge; extreme long legs and enlarged fin span remain. Near glove has five separated digits, far glove fingers curled and bases occluded. Two arms and legs connected; boot toes inside tight margins. Faint-body overlay incorrectly clusters around face and detects no hands; automated geometry unusable.
